purpose: 실제 사용할 온전한 파츠와 가려진 면 원화
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an actual production source-parts atlas for a layered 2D game sprite, using image 1 as exact material, palette and hand-painted style reference. This is NOT an animation sheet and NOT a preview. Draw a square transparent canvas divided conceptually into a clean 2 by 2 grid with no drawn grid lines. Each of the three requested source layers is fully contained in its own cell with ample transparent separation: top-left fixed complete base, top-right complete movable piece A, bottom-left complete movable piece B, bottom-right completely empty transparent. Do not add text, labels, frames, background, shadows outside the objects, numbers, watermarks or tools. Preserve the source's smooth warm cream highlights, even dark teal/olive contours, calm botanical fantasy illustration rendering, soft top-left light, and slightly overhead 3/4 perspective. Every individual piece must be a finished WHOLE object including all hidden/back/side edges, not a cropped visible fragment, not a clipped polygon, not an animation sequence, not alternate poses. The base must have a fully painted continuous intact underlying surface behind the removable pieces, no holes, no gaps, no empty silhouettes, no cut walls, no clone stripes or smeared texture. The parts will move only 1 to 4 degrees and return, so intact overlaps and a clean finished neutral appearance matter. Do not repeat the movable pieces on the fixed base. Keep object size and source design close to the reference. All cells genuine transparent alpha.
Source image 1 is a milky white pale aqua quartz crystal cluster. TOP-LEFT: a complete fixed source layer containing ONLY the main tall rear quartz prism and its entire low pale stony crystal foot/base. Paint the main crystal faces and complete base behind two smaller prisms so there are no holes or missing surfaces. Leave out the left leaning prism and the small front prism. TOP-RIGHT: a complete separate smaller quartz crystal prism for the left side, milky-white translucent pale-aqua hexagonal column with a softly pointed tip, full uncut lower root and all hidden sides, naturally slightly leaning left. BOTTOM-LEFT: a second complete separate short front quartz prism, same milky pale-aqua hexagonal material and softly pointed tip, full root and complete hidden sides. The small prisms will pivot only one or two degrees about their roots and return while still attached. No purple gems, no glitter cloud, no glow, no cropped bases.
